reference: The stag, whose antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
sk: Jeleň, ktorého parohy boli obrovské, stál medzi lístím.
cz: Jelen, jehož parohy byly obrovské, stál mezi listím.
acceptable: The {stag|deer}, whose antlers were {huge|enormous|massive|giant|gigantic}, {stood|was standing} {among|in} the leaves.

mistakes.text: The {stag|deer}, which antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “whose” for possession (the stag's antlers): “whose antlers”, not “which antlers”.

mistakes.text: The {stag|deer}, whose the antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „whose“ nepatrí člen, „whose“ ho nahrádza: „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „whose“ se člen nepíše, „whose“ ho nahrazuje: „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Whose” already works like a determiner, so no article follows it: “whose antlers”.

mistakes.text: The {stag|deer}, who antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Who“ nevyjadruje vlastníctvo. Pri „ktorého parohy“ treba „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Who“ nevyjadřuje vlastnictví. U „jehož parohy“ je potřeba „whose antlers“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Who” can't show possession; for the stag's antlers use “whose antlers”.

mistakes.text: The {stag|deer}, its antlers were huge, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cez „its“ sa vety takto spojiť nedajú. Vedľajšiu vetu uvedie „whose“: „whose antlers were huge“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pomocí „its“ se věty takto spojit nedají. Vedlejší větu uvede „whose“: „whose antlers were huge“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “its antlers were huge” can't sit inside the sentence like this; a relative clause needs “whose”.

mistakes.text: The {stag|deer} with {huge|enormous} antlers stood among the leaves.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu sa precvičuje vedľajšia veta so „whose“: „The stag, whose antlers were huge, …“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady se procvičuje vedlejší věta s „whose“: „The stag, whose antlers were huge, …“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Practise the relative clause here: “The stag, whose antlers were huge, …”.

mistakes.text: The {stag|deer}, which had {huge|enormous} antlers, stood among the leaves.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Vlastníctvo tu priamejšie vyjadrí „whose“: „whose antlers were huge“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Vlastnictví tu přímočařeji vyjádří „whose“: „whose antlers were huge“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “whose antlers were huge” expresses possession more directly and is the structure practised here.
